subject: Preserve facing on translated damage reactions
description: Commit `613d3d092d963a98de92726236bc7d3d80bfc9f5` restores Original's `RHOrder::bComputeDirection=false` on every direct reaction order authored by the human damage translators. The shared insertion boundary now covers generic and mobile damage, arrow and stone damage, sword parry/hit/stunning chains, hit falls, lethal and knockout reactions, ladder falls, push successors, and both sides of shoulder-fall handling. This matches `TranslateDamage`, `TranslateArrowDamage`, `TranslateSwordDamage`, `TranslateHitDamage`, and `TranslatePushDamage`, whose direct reaction orders explicitly disable direction recomputation (`original-code/RHelementactorhuman.cpp:2295-2304,2441-2477,2513-2697,2729-2767,11550-11719`), plus both PC shoulder-partner `RHCOMMAND_FALL` translations (`original-code/RHelementactorpc.cpp:2882-2904`). The separate `TranslateRoll` successor deliberately retains the default direction-enabled order (`original-code/RHelementactorhuman.cpp:11997-12035`); a steep-slope control protects that distinction. Command-level regressions cover generic, mobile, arrow, stone, sword, push, and shoulder-partner paths, including direct-reaction false-facing and `Rolling` true-facing controls; the focused damage/melee set passed 47/47 together with the dedicated regressions. This fix is independently source-proven but is required by Task404's restored post-Execute `CheckForLineCrossing` boundary: once `FindPlaceToDie` relocates a dying actor, Task404 correctly consumes the live order's authored compute-direction flag rather than inventing one. A fresh optimized runner containing Task404 commit `9f3ccfa9494a10f774303e3d6166a771a0f8b964` and this commit matches every recorded frame for the schema-12 representative `parity-random-save-replays-60s-15x/traces/Savegame_nicouzouf/Profile_001/Savegame_041/replay-007-session-0001.jsonl.zst` and nearby schema-12 control `parity-random-save-replays-60s-15x/traces/Savegame_nicouzouf/Profile_001/Savegame_041/replay-006-session-0001.jsonl.zst`; both reach exact EOF at `final_frame=1511` with `frame_count=1500`.
